review_role: Cross-module source/timing/graphic review. This reviewer authored the candidate narration and process module; this record is not independent approval of those own deliverables.
method: Read actual script, shot plan, editorial renderer and director
Compared narration text against generated audio timeline
Rendered reporting shots in NAPI Canvas at 15% and 85% progress and compared exact PNG hashes
Ran world-space triangle aperture rays and paired-door bounds after process fix

findings.problem: Earlier f09 restarted docking while narration said the handling robot could only then access wafers.
findings.correction_observed: handoff ends at73.794667; f08 second shot enters EFEM atp.16; load event continues through f09, whose first shot starts atp.418388 with door already clear. Actual generated narration text matches the script.
findings.remaining: Full movie frame/audio inspection still needed.

findings.problem: layers view begins atprocess p.235700, after deposition has finished atp.18. Adding the layer is therefore never visible. pattern starts atp.471399, then development begins about1.43s later.
findings.proposed_fix: Give each selected operation its own shot-local clock: chamber .20-.72; layers0-.34; pattern .34-.70; etch .70-1. Layer states remain continuous across their three cuts; chamber is a separately framed machine/principle.

findings.problem: Original f29 replayed the prior EFEM extraction atp.82-.98 after the work had completed.
findings.correction_observed: Replaced by a newly authored handoff-data reporting graphic. Add its explicit eFoundry/DTCO source entry to sourceByView rather than the generic fallback.

findings.problem: 13 reporting shots are exactly identical at15% and85% local progress, covering143.354s. The f31-f34 history block has48.235s of entirely static internal pictures. This directly risks repeating the user's unchanged-picture complaint.
findings.proposed_fix: Reveal distinct evidence, responsibility or consequence in narrated stages; prioritize collaboration, founding, report, customers, commitments and wafer-risk. Moving a decorative dot alone does not resolve the editorial issue.
findings.not_claimed: PNG equality is not an audience-quality test; a deliberate held image is not automatically an error.

findings.problem: The arrow labelled design + rules runs designer-to-foundry, teaching the wrong principal direction for foundry design rules.
findings.proposed_fix: Forward: design + requirements. Return: process rules + data.

findings.problem: All subsequent chip icons become green after a process change, implying confirmed recovery without new verification.
findings.proposed_fix: Keep future material neutral; show CHANGE then VERIFY. Only make success conditional on a new verification step, not a guaranteed consequence.

findings.problem: The same patterned wafer with red X defects recurs four times; measurement, containment and wafer-risk repeat the left-wafer/right-text composition.
findings.proposed_fix: For wafer-risk emphasize the dated payment obligation and what yield uncertainty changes, rather than presenting the same red-X wafer again. Do not invent invoice prices, quantities or private contract graphics.

findings.problem: The illustrative Product B route visually skips coating before exposure.
findings.proposed_fix: Use the explicit label Selected tool visits; intervening steps omitted, or include the omitted prerequisites. Do not present this as a full valid process recipe.

process_module_fix.cause: Hardware loadport envelope changed from1.286m to1.386m; a height-specific removal filter left a solid backplate across the process aperture.
process_module_fix.implementation: Rebuild full local fascia while retaining only table and door assemblies. Align local loadport front door plane to FOUP by initial and animated z=-.1855 before withdrawal.
process_module_fix.scope_limit: Sampled aperture/contact geometry check, not a full swept-volume collision proof, dynamic simulation or OEM reconstruction certification. Current visual render still requires integrated review.
